what: This is a preferred unit of Brookfield Property Partners, the global property owner holding offices, shopping centres, hotels, logistics and residential assets. It pays a fixed distribution and ranks ahead of the ordinary units but behind all debt.
customers: The underlying properties serve office and retail tenants, hotel guests and residents; this security is bought by income investors.
money: rent from offices and shopping centres
moat: A portfolio of prime properties in major cities, managed by Brookfield, whose access to capital has supported these securities through a severe office downturn.
risks: Office values have fallen sharply since 2020
Consolidated debt is very large relative to the equity beneath these units
Revenue fell about 22% last year as assets were sold
The distribution is discretionary and ranks behind every lender
opportunities: Paid before ordinary unitholders receive anything
Retail and logistics assets in the portfolio have held up better than offices
watch: Asset sales, debt levels, and whether the preferred distribution keeps being paid.
